text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I happen to spot Shinko Windy in a<n>field with a
shovel in hand. It seems<n>like she's attempting to
dig a pitfall.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... I'm gonna scare the pants<n>off 'em...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She begins digging, but stops almost<n>immediately.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll call it a day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy appears to be rather<n>fatigued from all
the racing she's<n>been doing. I should probably
revise<n>her race schedule.
